short_description.id: Sihuhata adalah makhluk cerita rakyat Lanna Thailand utara, biasanya memiliki empat telinga dan lima mata.
short_description.en: Sihuhata is a creature of Northern Thailand's Lanna folklore, usually having four ears and five eyes.

long_description.id: Sihuhata adalah makhluk cerita rakyat Lanna Thailand utara, biasanya memiliki empat telinga dan lima mata. Satu versi naskah menggambarkan makhluk mirip beruang yang makan arang menyala dan menghasilkan kotoran emas.
long_description.en: Sihuhata is a creature of Northern Thailand's Lanna folklore, usually having four ears and five eyes. One manuscript version describes a bearlike creature eating burning charcoal and producing gold as excrement.

long_description.id: Sebagian tradisi menyebutnya sebagai Indra yang menguji kebajikan manusia. Kisahnya disimpan dalam naskah daun lontar Tham Sihuhata dari Wat Chae Chang. Seorang anak menangkap makhluk itu dan membawanya pulang; ia menolak rumput dan daun. Emas itu memungkinkan anak tersebut membangun saluran air emas dan menikahi putri raja.
long_description.en: Some traditions identify it as Indra testing a person's virtue. Its story is preserved in the palm-leaf manuscript Tham Sihuhata from Wat Chae Chang. A boy catches the creature and brings it home; it refuses grass and leaves. The gold enables the boy to build a golden water channel and marry the king's daughter.

long_description.id: Dalam penceritaan ulang legenda di sebuah artikel jurnal, seorang anak laki-laki menangkap hewan aneh seperti beruang berbulu hitam dengan empat telinga dan lima mata. Keesokan harinya ia mendapati hewan itu telah mencerna bara menjadi emas. Dengan bantuan Indra, ia membangun talang air emas dan menikahi sang putri, sedangkan raja yang meminta makhluk itu dibawa kepadanya mendapati makhluk itu lari ketakutan.
long_description.en: In the legend as retold in a journal article, a boy catches a strange animal like a bear, with black hair, four ears and five eyes. The next day he finds the animal has digested the coals into gold. With the help of Indra he builds the gold water gutter and marries the princess, while the king who asks for the creature to be brought finds that it is frightened and runs away.

claims.quote: It is usually described as a large animal with four ears and five eyes.

statement.id: Sihuhata adalah makhluk cerita rakyat Lanna Thailand utara, biasanya memiliki empat telinga dan lima mata.
statement.en: Sihuhata is a creature of Northern Thailand's Lanna folklore, usually having four ears and five eyes.

claims.quote: In one Lanna manuscript version, it resembles a bear, eats burning charcoal, and produces gold as excrement.

statement.id: Satu versi naskah menggambarkan makhluk mirip beruang yang makan arang menyala dan menghasilkan kotoran emas.
statement.en: One manuscript version describes a bearlike creature eating burning charcoal and producing gold as excrement.

claims.quote: In some traditions, Sihuhata is identified with the Hindu deity Indra, who takes the creature's form to test a person's virtue.

statement.id: Sebagian tradisi menyebutnya sebagai Indra yang menguji kebajikan manusia.
statement.en: Some traditions identify it as Indra testing a person's virtue.

claims.quote: Sihuhata's story is preserved in a Lanna palm-leaf manuscript entitled Tham Sihuhata (ธัมม์สี่หูห้าตา), from Wat Chae Chang in San Kamphaeng District, Chiang Mai. The manuscript consists of 61 palm-leaf pages and was written in Lanna script by Phimmasan Bhikkhu in 1914.

statement.id: Kisahnya disimpan dalam naskah daun lontar Tham Sihuhata dari Wat Chae Chang.
statement.en: Its story is preserved in the palm-leaf manuscript Tham Sihuhata from Wat Chae Chang.

claims.quote: He brings the animal home and tries to feed it grass and leaves, but it refuses them.

statement.id: Seorang anak menangkap makhluk itu dan membawanya pulang; ia menolak rumput dan daun.
statement.en: A boy catches the creature and brings it home; it refuses grass and leaves.

claims.quote: The poor boy hires a group of Chinese merchants to build the channel, which is completed in one night. He subsequently marries Simma and becomes the king's son-in-law.

statement.id: Emas itu memungkinkan anak tersebut membangun saluran air emas dan menikahi putri raja.
statement.en: The gold enables the boy to build a golden water channel and marry the king's daughter.

claims.quote: After three days he caught a strange animal that was like a bear, with black hair, and had got four ears and five eyes.

statement.id: Dalam penceritaan ulang legenda di jurnal ini, setelah tiga hari seorang anak laki-laki menangkap hewan aneh seperti beruang berbulu hitam dengan empat telinga dan lima mata.
statement.en: In the legend as retold in this journal article, after three days a boy caught a strange animal like a bear, with black hair, four ears and five eyes.

claims.quote: The next day the boy was very surprised to see that the strange beast had digested the coals into gold.

statement.id: Keesokan harinya anak itu terkejut melihat hewan aneh itu telah mencerna bara menjadi emas.
statement.en: The next day the boy was very surprised to see the strange beast had digested the coals into gold.

claims.quote: With the help of Indra, the young boy was able to build the gold water gutter and marry the princess.

statement.id: Dengan bantuan Indra, anak muda itu mampu membangun talang air emas dan menikahi sang putri.
statement.en: With the help of Indra, the young boy was able to build the gold water gutter and marry the princess.

claims.quote: The king asked further to bring Mang Si Hu Ha Ta, but the beast was frightening and ran away.

statement.id: Raja meminta agar makhluk itu dibawa kepadanya, tetapi makhluk itu ketakutan dan lari.
statement.en: The king asked for the creature to be brought, but the beast was frightened and ran away.
